fields.name: canGoOverTerrain
fields.summary: Can this displacement go over terrain/go through walls?If this is false, the displacement might end up not reaching the desired destination.Default value is true.

fields.name: curve
fields.summary: Cubic bezier parameter. Use this to curve the movement trajectory.https://cubic-bezier.com/

fields.name: curveHorizontalDistance
fields.summary: Set the horizontal sway magnitude of the curve.If not set, the curve will be scaled to the length of the linear line.

fields.name: destination
fields.summary: Destination of this displacement. You should feed in a valid agent position using Dew.GetValidAgentPosition()

fields.name: ease
fields.summary: Type of ease function that this displacement will follow over its course.
